INFRASTRUCTURE_RATE_LIMIT.name: Infrastructure Rate Limit
INFRASTRUCTURE_RATE_LIMIT.description: Upstream API rate limit error (HTTP 429: Too Many Requests) interrupted agent execution during concurrency bursts.

OVERCONSTRAINED_SEARCH_LOOP.name: Overconstrained Search Loop
OVERCONSTRAINED_SEARCH_LOOP.maps_to: None (Emergent multi-hop search pathology / Partial F6)
OVERCONSTRAINED_SEARCH_LOOP.description: Model issued overconstrained multi-word search queries returning 0 candidates, looping through reformulations until step cap 12.

MALFORMED_TOOL_CALL.name: Malformed Tool Call
MALFORMED_TOOL_CALL.description: Model emitted unstructured text reasoning without valid tool JSON, causing harness parsing errors.

INFRASTRUCTURE_SERVER_ERROR.name: Infrastructure Server Error
INFRASTRUCTURE_SERVER_ERROR.description: Upstream API backend 500 internal server error interrupted execution.

MULTI_HOP_TRAVERSAL_EXHAUSTION.name: Multi-Hop Traversal Exhaustion
MULTI_HOP_TRAVERSAL_EXHAUSTION.description: Model productively traversed multiple hops on T3 but ran out of the 12-step budget before reaching the terminal document.

RETRIEVAL_FAILURE_ABSTENTION.name: Retrieval Failure Abstention
RETRIEVAL_FAILURE_ABSTENTION.description: Model failed to locate the document in initial searches and explicitly emitted a refusal/abstention response.

ANSWER_EXTRACTION_TRUNCATION.name: Answer Extraction Truncation
ANSWER_EXTRACTION_TRUNCATION.description: Model retrieved the correct document and cited it, but truncated the token string in extraction (e.g., Onyx instead of Onyx-4413).

PREMATURE_STOP_WRONG_HOP.name: Premature Stop at Wrong Hop
PREMATURE_STOP_WRONG_HOP.description: Model halted at step 2 on a 3-hop task and emitted an intermediate entity attribute as the final answer.

MULTI_HOP_DIRECTION_ERROR.name: Multi-Hop Direction Error
MULTI_HOP_DIRECTION_ERROR.description: Model searched in the reverse dependency direction across multi-hop entity links.
